steps: Introduce two new red dice falling into the frame from the top and right, applying motion blur to indicate high velocity.
Show the falling dice impacting the white surface and colliding with the original dice, causing the left-most die to be pushed further back.
Bring all four dice to a complete stop, removing motion blur and positioning them in a scattered arrangement across the table.
Drop the first few strawberries into the blender, showing motion blur as they fall.
Increase the flow of strawberries, filling the air above the blender with many falling fruits.
Clear the air as the strawberries finish falling and settle at the bottom of the blender.
Grasp the pedal and begin rotating the crank arm clockwise.
Continue rotating the crank arm to pull the chain toward the top of the chainring.
Use both hands to align the chain links with the chainring teeth while completing the rotation until the chain is fully seated.
Introduce a red die falling from the top right toward the stack with visible motion blur.
Depict the falling die colliding with the right side of the stack, causing the two rightmost dice to tumble and scatter to the right.
Move the scattered dice further to the right as they lose momentum, with the foreground die becoming out of focus.
Tip the first domino on the left forward to strike the second one, creating motion blur as the first few tiles begin to fall.
Propagate the falling motion through the center of the row, showing the dominoes leaning into each other in a continuous wave.
Complete the sequence so that all dominoes have fallen and settled into a stable, overlapping resting position on the table.
Move the coin down to the surface and tilt it slightly as it makes initial contact.
Lower the tilted edge of the coin closer to the surface as it begins to settle.
Place the coin completely flat on the surface in its final resting position.
Lift the rear wheel off the dirt path while the person begins to step forward with their left foot.
Maintain the wheel's elevation as the person completes their stride, allowing the wheel to rotate slightly in the air.
Lower the rear wheel back onto the ground and extend the kickstand to a supporting position.
Destabilize the tower so the blocks on the right side begin to fall and scatter at the base.
Complete the collapse of the structure until all blocks form a disorganized heap.
Settle the pile further, spreading the blocks outward to reveal a white sphere resting in the center.
Collapse the first few dominoes on the left so they lie flat on the surface.
Tilt the middle section of the domino line forward as the chain reaction continues.
Complete the chain reaction by knocking down the remaining upright dominoes on the right.
Show coins falling through the air towards the open mouth of the glass jar.
Render three coins inside the jar, with some tilted or mid-bounce after hitting the bottom.
Position the three coins so they are lying flat and stationary at the base of the jar.
Bullet impacts left side; small entry debris cloud forms.
Massive debris cloud erupts from right side; skin peels back.
Debris clouds expand outward; apple body deforms further.
The man's left hand dribbling the basketball as it contacts the ground, hand moving slightly downward simultaneously
The basketball rebounding upward toward the man's right hand, not yet making con
The man's right hand making contact with the ball, extending slightly outward to absorb the momentum
The upper ram descends, closing the gap to contact the aluminum cube
The cube is compressed vertically and expands horizontally, losing its cubic shape
The cube is flattened completely into a thin disk structure
Bullet travels right, impacting the banana skin and initiating penetration
Projectile traverses banana, causing explosive exit rupture and pulp ejection
Banana structure disintegrates, peeling apart while debris scatters outward
The woman holding the bow with an arrow nocked, right elbow slightly raised, lightly drawing the bowstring
The woman straightening the bow into a ready stance, drawing the bowstring further but not yet fully drawn
The woman drawing the bow further, low-angle view shifting upward, her raised elbow partially obscuring most of her face
Hydraulic ram descends, contacts apple, and initiates vertical compression
Continued compression causes lateral expansion, skin rupture, and juice release
Apple is completely flattened and crushed into pulp
Bottle impacts surface, bottom fractures, and fine debris sprays outward
Glass shatters completely, shards fly radially, revealing yellow interior
Debris field expands and settles; yellow object rests on ground
The white bubble ball making initial contact with the ground, not yet compressed
The white bubble ball beginning to compress upon contact with the ground, deformation underway but not yet reaching maximum
The white bubble ball compressing beyond its maximum deformation limit, rupturing and releasing a burst of white mist
Hand seals bottle opening; upper walls begin to buckle inward
Bottle body collapses rapidly inward, drastically reducing internal volume
Bottle reaches fully crumpled state and deformation stabilizes
Hands accelerate the chocolate eggs inward, reducing the distance between them.
Eggs collide; kinetic energy converts to mechanical stress, initiating shell fracture.
Cracks propagate rapidly, resulting in catastrophic shattering and ejected debris.
Drop an effervescent tablet into the glass of water so it sinks to the bottom and begins releasing a stream of bubbles.
Increase the intensity of the effervescence, filling the volume of the water with a dense cloud of rising bubbles.
Allow the tablet to fully dissolve, resulting in a uniformly cloudy liquid with a thin layer of foam at the surface.
Introduce a vertical stream of blue liquid into the center of the petri dish, showing it splashing and spreading outward.
Remove the pouring stream and show the blue liquid continuing to expand with visible concentric ripples at the impact site.
Let the ripples dissipate and the liquid settle into a flatter, more stable pool covering a larger area of the dish.
Add more lime slices entering the water from the top, increasing the splash and bubble density as they begin to sink.
Disperse the lime slices further down into the frame, increasing the volume of small air bubbles throughout the water.
Remove the peripheral lime slices as they sink out of view, leaving two central pieces surrounded by a fine mist of rising bubbles.
Move the paper boat slightly forward and to the right, maintaining its orientation on the water surface.
Shift the paper boat further towards the bottom right corner, increasing its scale to show it approaching the camera.
Remove the paper boat from the scene as it floats completely out of the camera's field of view.
Rotate the central fluid vortex clockwise, shifting the pink and teal bands slightly along the flow lines.
Elongate the fluid filaments as they spiral outward from the center, increasing the curvature of the marble patterns.
Further diffuse the color boundaries and continue the rotational flow to create more intricate, thin streaks of pigment.
Move the boat from the right edge toward the center, extending the white wake trail behind it.
Advance the boat further to the left side of the frame, lengthening the wake trail across the water.
Remove the boat from the left edge of the frame, leaving only the dissipating wake visible on the water surface.
Increase the density of the bubble trail rising from the tablets at the bottom of the glass.
Slightly reduce the volume of the white tablets as they dissolve and shift the pattern of the rising bubbles higher in the water column.
Further erode the tablets' edges and maintain the steady stream of carbon dioxide bubbles reaching the top of the glass.
Shift the fog layer slightly to the right, revealing more of the central tree silhouettes and thinning the mist in the middle ground.
Continue the rightward drift of the fog, exposing more of the green foliage on the far right side of the frame.
Move the fog further to the right, partially obscuring the lower left foreground while clearing the view of the lower right trees.
Begin pouring liquid directly onto the top surface of the ice cube, creating wet reflections and ripples.
Continue pouring liquid to raise the level in the glass, causing the ice cube to become mostly submerged.
Stop the pour and allow the liquid to settle, with the ice cube now fully surrounded by the increased volume of liquid.
Shift the central blue and yellow bands slightly to the left and downward, creating a more pronounced curve in the color boundaries.
Continue the swirling motion, stretching the yellow and orange bands further into the blue region and introducing more intricate ripples in the pink and green areas.
Further deform the color bands, causing the central blue area to narrow and the surrounding warm tones to wrap around it.
Slightly lift the bottom edge of the white sheer curtain and introduce a subtle curve as it begins to catch the wind.
Increase the billowing effect of the white curtain, creating more pronounced folds and moving the fabric further into the room.
Shift the folds of the white curtain slightly to show continuous movement, maintaining the lifted position of the bottom hem.
Generate a ring of white foam and translucent liquid butter around the base of the solid pat.
Expand the diameter of the bubbling liquid ring and slightly reduce the volume of the central solid butter.
Increase the density and size of the bubbles in the liquid butter while the central solid piece continues to shrink.
Lower the kite's altitude and tilt its nose further down and to the right, causing the tail to curve upwards.
Shift the kite upwards and to the left, rotating the body so the nose points towards the top left, with the tail trailing behind in a long arc.
Rotate the kite back to a more upright position and center it, allowing the tail to ripple naturally in the wind.
Slightly shorten the candle as it burns and curve the wick further.
Continue the burning process, further reducing the candle's length and smoothing the wax rim around the flame.
Significantly shorten the candle and add prominent wax drips running down the side.
Tilt the head and stem of the central poppy flower slightly to the right.
Increase the bend in the stem to move the flower head further to the right.
Shift the flower head slightly back toward the left as the sway begins to reverse.
Bring a hot soldering iron tip into contact with the end of the solder wire, initiating the release of smoke.
Maintain contact until the tip of the wire melts into a liquid bead that adheres to the soldering iron.
Pull the soldering iron away from the wire, keeping the molten solder bead on the iron's tip while smoke continues to rise.
Bend the flower stems and tilt the petals slightly to the right.
Increase the rightward tilt of the flowers and add a small flying insect near the center cluster.
Move the flowers slightly back toward the center as the breeze eases, keeping the insect in flight.
Begin pouring a thin stream of water onto the center of the dry coffee grounds.
Continue pouring water in a circular motion to saturate the grounds, causing them to swell and rise.
Stop the water flow and allow the coffee to bloom, with bubbles forming on the surface of the wet slurry.
Detach the seeds from the top and right side of the dandelion head and scatter them into the air towards the right.
Remove most of the remaining seeds from the stem and move the airborne seeds further away and out of the frame.
Clear the floating seeds from the air, leaving only the central core of the dandelion with one seed still attached at the top.
Begin melting the ice cream scoops, causing liquid to pool around the base and softening the sharp edges of the chocolate portion.
Continue the melting process so the scoops lose their spherical shape and the liquid pool expands significantly across the surface.
Complete the melting until the scoops collapse into a thick, blended puddle of chocolate and vanilla liquid, with only small solid remnants remaining.
